entries.title: Claude crewmates on a computer you update keep their task
entries.body: When a computer that runs work for you updates, a Claude crewmate working there can have to start a new conversation. It is now told its task's brief and where its earlier conversation is saved, as a crewmate on this Mac already is, so it carries on with its task instead of starting without it.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen looks different: the change is in what the crewmate is told, so its next turn picks the task up where it left off.
